mappings.parent_claim_text: The frozen literature supplies subgroup, ambient-conjugacy, arithmetic, and hyperbolic-group components but not an executed complete oriented Gamma_0(11) owner solver with replayable positive and negative certificates.

The primary mathematical certificate target is a deterministic canonicalization map together with a proved biconditional: two inputs have the same canonical owner exactly when they represent the same oriented primitive Gamma_0(11) owner.

The 9,453-row all-pairs table is retained as a derived adversarial regression audit, while aggregate class counts remain post-closure controls; neither is presumed to be the uniquely necessary proof architecture.

The global owner table G, incidence relation I, and cell-local quotient C are distinct estimands and may be populated only after the canonical owner contract closes with zero unresolved rows on the frozen population.

A complete certificate contract must preserve orientation, primitive-root status, inverse linkage, subgroup membership, deterministic serialization, and replayable failure evidence without conflating Hecke degree with traversal repetition.
The report's contribution is a certificate-methods architecture that separates a canonical proof object, its full-population adversarial audit, and downstream G/I/C estimands.
Metadata and source-identity closure does not clear claim-level passages, retraction status, source conflicts, or the theorem-to-certificate bridge because all inherited locators are absent.
Phase-6 revision remains A1-only and changes no scientific result, formal Route-A tuple, positive arithmetic A2 status, Route-B status, formal project claim, or canonical manuscript result.
